SASBDB entry SASDJY2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDJY2/)

Publication: Activity and structure of EcoKMcrA
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gky731

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDJY2/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
